disposition_reason: The legacy 2795-cue mean-response predictor is a scoped artifact/programme task, not the full licking-controlled time-versus-count investigation; its two public scorer bridges depend on absent authoring files. The newer shared programme defines matched AUC-model contrasts but refuses authentic runs and model fitting. Bind endpoint identity and qualify native inputs, support and full comparator execution before inference.

scientific_target.question: Given distinguishable elapsed-conditioning-time and delivered-reward-count support, do matched held-animal models predict measured cue/reward fluorescence differently after permitted licking and condition covariates are controlled?
scientific_target.known_answer: Observed native fluorescence-derived responses provide prediction targets; the scientific answer is the independently recomputed signed loss contrasts and their uncertainty, which may favor time, count, neither, both or non-identifiability. No favored paper conclusion is an answer key.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Released photometry plus verified native clocks and event/lick anchors. Current programme primary uses cue integral difference; historical mean-difference responses are a distinct target, not interchangeable labels.
scientific_target.case_unit: Eligible cue or separately declared reward/omission/aversive response within a session and biological animal. Historical scalar scope fixes 2795 cue identities in 13 source animals.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Verified biological animal, with all source aliases and sessions grouped. Historical source-ID independence and anatomical support still need confirmation.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Conditional predictive comparison on exposed processed fluorescence under declared model classes and covariates. It does not identify causal learning mechanisms, prove unique E/N information from ridge gains, or establish future-data-free neural forecasting.
exclusions: No reward for producing a larger positive Delta or a significant preferred biological story.
No pooling of legacy mean-difference and current AUC responses, or appetitive and aversive units.
No canonical licking-controlled conclusion from the historical scalar panel, where missing-lick and lifetime-history provenance are unresolved.

inputs: Only outer-training response labels/native traces and permitted event covariates: elapsed released-log duration E, delivered-reward count N, condition, sex, day/session and declared licking/history/hardware information.
Current numerical full-comparison controls expose axes needed for M0, ME, MN and MEN; input-removed controls must omit incompatible models and contrasts.
Legacy per-animal folds use asset_id plus original zero-based cue_event_row0 and event features; stable source identities remain exposed and can facilitate memorization.
forbidden_inputs: Outer-held response targets, target-based feature scaling, other-fold labels/state or prior scoring outputs.
Missing E/N/lick information inferred from answer-bearing data or privately supplied comparator predictions.
Any future/concurrent nuisance information in an arm declared cue-time only; consumption-anchored reward responses require verified lick support.
observation_contract.case_identity: Legacy 2795 unique (asset_id,cue_event_row0) pairs are selected by a timestamp-only mask from 2797 cue slots. The new programme uses biological animal/session/event keys and separate endpoint eligibility ledgers; authentic full roster is external and unqualified.
observation_contract.split: Current primary leaves whole biological animals out within conditions and requires that held conditions have training support; transfer leaves complete conditions out with verified physical protocol descriptors. Alias overlap is rejected. Legacy 13-fold training-label union exposes every assessment target, even when individual fold files are separated.
observation_contract.coverage: Legacy cue mean panel is retained as scalar prediction calibration. Current design separately requires primary cue AUC and consumption-anchored reward, omission and aversive endpoints with full source-condition support statuses; neither generated examples nor historical 2795 predictions establish that coverage.

primary.name: Paired animal-macro held-out AUC-response MSE contrasts for matched M0, ME, MN and MEN
primary.aggregation: Average squared errors within each biological animal and then equally across animals; report Delta=L(MN)-L(ME), G_E=L(MN)-L(MEN), G_N=L(ME)-L(MEN), and both single-axis gains over M0 on identical eligible cases.
primary.rationale: A signed scientific contrast distinguishes better predictive models without rewarding a predetermined sign. Current cue target is the native integral over [cue,cue+0.5s) minus the integral over [cue-0.5s,cue), using observed spans, in stored fluorescence-times-seconds units. The legacy target instead divides each integral by its own observed span and subtracts the means; its MSE cannot be pooled or treated as the same endpoint.

secondary: Each model's absolute animal-macro MSE, complete per-animal/condition results, prediction coverage and stratified/equal-session sensitivities.
Independently tuned MEN sensitivity; raw E/N support, nuisance-conditioned rank/residual diagnostics and practical overlap/precision limits.
Distinct mean-difference and baseline-span-corrected-AUC sensitivities; separately identified consumption, omission and aversive endpoints.
Legacy mean-response MSE, MAE and bias retained in their original stored-fluorescence units only.

comparators.name: Current matched nuisance/elapsed/count/joint models
comparators.inputs: M0 uses permitted nuisance Z; ME adds E, MN adds N, MEN adds both.
comparators.procedure: Published source implements natural-cubic spline/ridge families with dimensions 3/5/7 and penalties 1e-4, 1e-2, 1, 1e2, 1e4, shared inner whole-animal selection for ME/MN and separately tuned MEN sensitivity. Authentic fitting and model-family adequacy remain unqualified.

comparators.name: Legacy five frozen regularized predictors
comparators.inputs: Constant, Z, Z+E, Z+N, Z+E+N on the original cue mean-response panel.
comparators.procedure: Preserve lambda-1, unpenalized-intercept, training-only transforms and animal-equal loss definitions as historical prediction comparisons. Added correlated columns may change nuisance shrinkage, so performance differences are not unique-information estimates.

comparators.name: Matched exposure and information controls
comparators.inputs: Opaque IDs, source-prior-only, E/N removal, neural pairing/timing destruction and behavior-removed arms as registered.
comparators.procedure: Keep unavailable model slots unavailable and compare permitted F/I numerical and model-assisted arms separately; packet-only supplied-evidence interpretation cannot generate missing neural contrasts.

nuisance_controls: Before response fitting inspect E/N rank and within-condition/animal/session overlap; numerical rank alone does not establish biological estimability.
Prespecify licking and condition covariates, physical timing, event semantics, anatomy and exclusion masks; missing licking is not zero licking.
Fit all model transforms/selection on outer-training animals only and preserve common assessment cases across models.
Audit regularization redistribution and matched flexibility; the strongest conclusion may be not identifiable or inconclusive.
Record public-source and cross-task exposure; private grading or per-fold isolation does not erase public target memorization.
evaluation.uncertainty: Use paired biological-animal loss vectors with conditions and shared training sets acknowledged. Existing fixed-fit bootstrap/SD/SE are descriptive; a confirmatory population interval requires separately qualified full refitting and alias independence. Never treat 2795 cues as independent animals.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require every declared model and exact query ID with finite predictions and committed artifacts before private-target access. Missing models, unsupported endpoints/conditions and failed refits stay visible; no private backfill, omitted animal, successful-only interval or sign/significance reward. Legacy artifacts must contain all2795 identities or whole-task abstention.

The current shared prepare.py chooses selected[auc] as the target and scoring.py grades model losses/contrasts; packet.py grades declarative claims about already supplied evidence. These are distinct endpoints and cognitive access claims.

Distinguished supplied-result packet interpretation from direct neural observation and matched numerical investigation.
